paragraphs: Ulla gropes the paths of his mother.

Mentioned in [Bava Batra 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.9b.2-5). According to [Rashi’s explanation](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bava_Batra.9b.5.3), he is Rav Sheshet; according to [Rabbeinu Gershom](https://www.sefaria.org/Rabbeinu_Gershom_on_Bava_Batra.9b.12), he is Rav Achadboi bar Ami. See their entries.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Rashi identifies the woman as Rav Sheshet’s mother. Rabbeinu Gershom identifies her as Rav Achadboi’s mother and Rav Sheshet’s former wetnurse.
The linked Bavli spells the epithet משגש, which can be rendered “disturbs.” Hyman’s printed heading has מגשש, “gropes.”
Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 975) confirms both מגשש and the reference to Bava Batra 9b. The translation follows his printed heading.
